name: episode_reflection_v1
description: Contract benchmark for Episode Memory reflection: assess the outcome from direct evidence, retain reusable lessons, and avoid treating unsupported success claims as durable memory.

tasks.description_for_judge: The setup episode is directly verified as successful. The consolidation artifact must report achieved with evidence and produce at least one memory candidate.
tasks.prompt: A previous QA Notes task was completed and verified. Briefly confirm that this reflection case should be treated as a verified reusable procedure.

rubric.check: The response recognizes that a directly verified successful episode can yield a reusable procedure.

episode.user_goal: Persist an edited QA Notes title after reopening.

outcome.final_state: The changed title remained visible after reopening.
outcome.final_answer: The title was saved and verified.

events.observation: After reopening, the edited title reverted; direct Save did not persist it.
Preview mode showed the changed title.
Edit mode showed the changed title after returning from Preview.
Save completed after the Preview-to-Edit transition.
The changed title remained visible after reopening the note.

tasks.description_for_judge: The episode claims success but contains no direct final proof. The consolidation artifact must report unknown and may legitimately produce no device memory.
tasks.prompt: Briefly confirm that an episode claiming success without a final result or screenshot should remain untrusted.

rubric.check: The response says unsupported success should not be treated as a verified reusable lesson.

episode.user_goal: Open Settings and verify the requested page.

tasks.description_for_judge: The episode has a structured failure and direct error evidence. The consolidation artifact must report not_achieved and retain at least one actionable failure lesson.
tasks.prompt: Briefly confirm that a failed device episode can be retained as an actionable guard rather than a successful procedure.

rubric.check: The response distinguishes an actionable failure lesson from a successful procedure.

episode.user_goal: Send the drafted message from the composer.

events.observation: Send failed because the recipient field was empty.

tasks.description_for_judge: The episode directly observes a transient IP value. Reflection should not retain the value as a Device Memory fact.
tasks.prompt: Briefly confirm that a transient IP address observed during a one-off task should not be retained as a reusable device fact.

rubric.check: The response says the one-off IP value should not become durable device memory.

episode.user_goal: Inspect the current IPv4 address without changing network settings.

outcome.final_state: The current IP Address, Subnet Mask, and Router were visible in the final screenshot.

events.observation: IP Address 192.0.2.10, Subnet Mask 255.255.255.0, and Router 192.0.2.1 are visible.
